arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import statistics
import math

# FY1981 monthly net outlays (in millions)
values = [59099, 53969, 54216, 57198, 54608, 55619, 58486, 53095, 53698, 64216, 56838, 76875]

# Calculate population standard deviation
mean = sum(values) / len(values)
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Population variance and standard deviation
population_variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in values) / len(values)
population_std = math.sqrt(population_variance)

print(f"Population Variance: {population_variance}")
print(f"Population Standard Deviation: {population_std}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredths: {round(population_std, 2)}")
EOF
